metadata.name: elite-communications-workspace
metadata.description: Screenshot-inspired navy communications workspace with small square metric and sequence cards, inbox, SMS drafts, campaigns and task preview.
features: Session-only drafts, sequence details and task checklist

specifications: All activity is clearly labeled sample data.
No messages are sent; drafts and checklist changes only last in the current preview session.
Small square cards use aspect-ratio 1; main reading panels remain wide.
September 25 spacing pass: consistent topbar and panel spacing, focus/hover states; coded sidebars group secondary workspace links in More workspaces.
Desktop-priority layout: preserve multi-column workspace down to 900px of available content width; keep narrower responsive layouts. WeWeb editor device selection is independent of saved page styles.
